title: Sticky Fingers
question: What two interruptions did the writer have?

meanings.usage: 指打扰或中断某人正在做的事情
指用于制作糕点的面团，通常含有黄油
形容让人感到烦恼或生气的事物
表示失望或担忧的情绪
通过说理使某人做某事或相信某事
门上用来转动开门的圆形把手
指需要签收的挂号邮件
描述粘性物质如糨糊、糖浆等的特性
把两种或多种东西混合在一起
形容没有声音或很安静的环境
电话响或打电话的动作

phrases.usage: 制作肉馅饼，指做一种含肉的烘焙食品

examples.en: I decided to make some meat pies for dinner.
examples.zh: 我决定做些肉馅饼作为晚餐。

phrases.usage: 拿起电话听筒，指接电话的动作

examples.en: She picked up the receiver and said hello.
examples.zh: 她拿起听筒说了声你好。

examples.en: Please ring back later when I'm free.
examples.zh: 请稍后再打过来。

examples.en: At last I hung up the receiver.
examples.zh: 最后我挂断了电话。

phrases.usage: 一...就...，强调两个动作紧接发生

examples.en: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang.
examples.zh: 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响了。

phrases.usage: 很快；不久，表示时间短暂

examples.en: In a short time I was busy mixing butter and flour.
examples.zh: 很快我就忙着搅拌黄油和面粉了。

examples.en: The doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead.
examples.zh: 门铃响得震耳欲聋。

examples.en: He wanted me to sign for a registered letter.
examples.zh: 他要我签收一封挂号信。

examples.en: My hands were soon covered with sticky pastry.
examples.zh: 我的手上很快沾满了黏糊糊的面团。

phrases.usage: 就在那时，强调恰好在某个时间点

examples.en: At exactly that moment, the telephone rang.
examples.zh: 就在那时，电话响了。

sentences.en: After breakfast, I sent the children to school and then I went to the shops.
sentences.zh: 早饭后，我把孩子们送到学校，然后就去商店了。

sentences.en: It was still early when I returned home.
The children were at school, my husband was at work and the house was quiet.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在学校，我丈夫去上班了，家里很安静。

sentences.en: So I decided to make some meat pies.
sentences.zh: 于是我决定做些肉馅饼。

sentences.en: In a short time I was busy mixing butter
sentences.zh: 没过多久，我就忙着搅和黄油

sentences.en: and flour and my hands were soon covered with sticky pastry.
sentences.zh: 和面粉，很快我的手上就沾满了黏糊糊的面团。

sentences.en: At exactly that moment, the telephone rang.
Nothing could have been more annoying.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比这更烦人的了。

sentences.en: I picked up the receiver between two sticky fingers and was dismayed when I recognized the voice of Helen Bates.
sentences.zh: 我用两根黏糊糊的手指拿起听筒，当认出海伦·贝茨的声音时，我感到很沮丧。

sentences.en: It took me ten minutes to persuade her to ring back later. At last I hung up the receiver.
sentences.zh: 我花了十分钟才说服她稍后再打来。最后我挂断了电话。

sentences.en: What a mess! There was pastry on my fingers, on the telephone, and on the doorknobs.
sentences.zh: 真是一团糟！我的手指上、电话上、门把手上都沾满了面团。

sentences.en: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead.
sentences.zh: 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响了，声音大得足以把死人吵醒。

sentences.en: This time it was the postman and he wanted me to sign for a registered letter!
sentences.zh: 这次是邮递员，他要我签收一封挂号信！

exercises.prompt: “沮丧；使沮丧” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: dismay · /dɪsˈmeɪ/ · 名词/动词 · 沮丧；使沮丧。表示失望或担忧的情绪

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：门把手
exercises.explain: doorknob · /ˈdɔːnɒb/ · 名词 · 门把手。门上用来转动开门的圆形把手

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：Please _____ later when I'm free.
exercises.explain: ring back：回电话，稍后再打来（请稍后再打过来。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：It was _____ early when I returned home.
exercises.explain: It was still early when I returned home. — 我回到家时，时间还早。

source.en: It was still early when I returned home.

exercises.prompt: “was/were + 动词-ing 可以用来描述故事发生的背景，为主要事件做铺垫。” 描述的是哪个语法点？
options: 一般过去时与过去进行时
be made of 询问材质
exercises.explain: 过去进行时描述背景：主语 + was/were + 动词-ing：在叙述过去事件时，先描述正在进行的动作作为背景，然后引入打断的事件。

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead.
options: 萨姆确信钱包一定是被村里人捡走了，
昨天我收到了我姐姐的一封信。
我刚回到厨房，门铃就响了，声音大得足以把死人吵醒。
售票员说。“我们只能到这里了。”
exercises.explain: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead. — 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响了，声音大得足以把死人吵醒。

source.en: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead.

grammar.title: 过去完成时与no sooner...than连用
grammar.definition: no sooner...than表示'一...就...'，no sooner后面用过去完成时，than后面用一般过去时，表示前一动作刚刚结束，后一动作就发生了。
grammar.structure: 主语 + had no sooner + 过去分词 + than + 主语 + 过去式动词
grammar.usage: 用于描述两个紧接发生的动作，强调时间上的紧密联系。相当于hardly...when...的结构。

examples.en: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang.
examples.zh: 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响了。

examples.en: She had no sooner entered the room than the phone rang.
examples.zh: 她一进房间，电话就响了。

examples.en: He had no sooner finished his homework than his friends called.
examples.zh: 他刚完成作业，他的朋友就打来电话了。

grammar.title: 否定最高级结构
grammar.definition: Nothing could have been more + 形容词原级 表示'没有什么比...更...'，是一种加强语气的否定最高级表达。
grammar.structure: Nothing could have been more + 形容词
grammar.usage: 用于表达某事物是某种状态中最极端的，强调程度很深。比直接用最高级更有强调效果。

examples.en: Nothing could have been more annoying.
examples.zh: 没有比这更烦人的了。

examples.en: Nothing could have been more beautiful.
examples.zh: 没有什么比这更美丽的了。

examples.en: Nothing could have been more exciting.
examples.zh: 没有什么比这更令人兴奋的了。

grammar.title: 过去进行时描述背景
grammar.definition: was/were + 动词-ing 可以用来描述故事发生的背景，为主要事件做铺垫。
grammar.usage: 在叙述过去事件时，先描述正在进行的动作作为背景，然后引入打断的事件。

examples.en: I was busy mixing butter and flour.
examples.zh: 我正忙着搅拌黄油和面粉。

examples.en: He was reading a book when the doorbell rang.
examples.zh: 门铃响时他正在看书。

examples.en: They were having dinner when the power went out.
examples.zh: 他们正在吃晚饭时停电了。

patterns.pattern: I had no sooner + 过去分词 + than + 主语 + 过去式动词

original.en: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang.
original.zh: 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响了。

examples.en: I had no sooner sat down than the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我刚坐下，电话就响了。

examples.en: She had no sooner opened the door than someone knocked.
examples.zh: 她刚开门，就有人敲门。

examples.en: We had no sooner started the game than it began to rain.
examples.zh: 我们刚开始比赛，天就下雨了。

patterns.pattern: Nothing could have been more + 形容词

original.en: Nothing could have been more annoying.

examples.en: Nothing could have been more disappointing.
examples.zh: 没有比这更令人失望的了。

examples.en: Nothing could have been more surprising.
examples.zh: 没有比这更令人惊讶的了。

examples.en: Nothing could have been more wonderful.
examples.zh: 没有比这更棒的了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were busy + 动词-ing

original.en: I was busy mixing butter and flour.
original.zh: 我正忙着搅拌黄油和面粉。

examples.en: She was busy writing her report.
examples.zh: 她正忙着写报告。

examples.en: They were busy preparing for the party.
examples.zh: 他们正忙着准备派对。

examples.en: He was busy cleaning the house.
examples.zh: 他正忙着打扫房子。

patterns.pattern: It took me + 时间 + to + 动词原形

original.en: It took me ten minutes to persuade her to ring back later.
original.zh: 我花了十分钟才说服她稍后再打来。

examples.en: It took me two hours to finish the work.
examples.zh: 我花了两个小时完成这项工作。

examples.en: It took them three days to reach the destination.
examples.zh: 他们花了三天才到达目的地。

examples.en: It took her five minutes to understand the problem.
examples.zh: 她花了五分钟才理解这个问题。
